passages.note: Bill overview lists Kavanagh as a co-sponsor of HB2853, which the Governor signed into law.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted section 15-2401.01 expands ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in public school, removing the prior narrow eligibility categories.
House Third Reading roll call shows Kavanagh voting Y on final passage of HB2853.

rows.reasoning: Kavanagh co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y at House Third Reading (Passed 31-26-3-0-0); the Governor signed it, and the enacted text (15-2401.01) expands "qualified student" to include any resident eligible to enroll in public school, making the empowerment scholarship account program universal, matching rung 5, "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family." He acted on this in the House, but since he now holds a seat in the other chamber of the same legislature, the record counts as in-term (V5 ruling, option B).
